question: Which sentiment class is the most accurately predicted by ELS systems?

evidence: Crowdworkers correctly identified 62% of the neutral, 85% of the positive, and 92% of the negative sentiments. Google Cloud correctly identified 88% of the neutral sentiments, but only 3% of the positive, and 19% of the negative sentiments. TensiStrength correctly identified 87.2% of the neutral sentiments, but 10.5% of the positive, and 8.1% of the negative sentiments. Rosette Text Analytics correctly identified 22.7% of neutral sentiments, 38.1% of negative sentiments and 40.9% of positive sentiments. The lowest and highest CCR pertains to tweets about Trump and Sanders for both Google Cloud and TensiStrength, Trump and Clinton for Rosette Text Analytics, and Clinton and Cruz for crowdworkers. title: Performance Comparison of Crowdworkers and NLP Tools onNamed-Entity Recognition and Sentiment Analysis of Political Tweets
answer_rationale: Among the ELS systems tested, TensiStrength correctly identified 87.2% of neutral sentiments, 10.5% of positive, and 8.1% of negative sentiments. Google Cloud identified 88% of neutral, 3% of positive, and 19% of negative. Rosette Text Analytics identified 22.7% of neutral, 38.1% of negative, and 40.9% of positive. The highest accuracy for negative sentiment was achieved by Rosette Text Analytics (38.1%), but the question asks for the most accurately predicted sentiment class by ELS systems overall. However, the evidence shows that for ELS systems, negative sentiment was the most accurately predicted by Rosette Text Analytics, but the question is asking for the most accurately predicted sentiment class by ELS systems overall. The evidence does not clearly indicate which sentiment class is most accurately predicted by ELS systems overall, but the highest accuracy for negative sentiment was achieved by Rosette Text Analytics (38.1%), which is higher than the accuracy for positive (40.9%) and neutral (22.7%) sentiments. Therefore, negative sentiment is the most accurately predicted sentiment class by ELS systems.
